prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: self-employed income evidence. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"Where an applicant is self-employed, Larkmere Mutual will normally require the most recent two years’ evidence of income. Acceptable evidence includes HMRC tax calculations, tax year overviews, and corresponding business accounts or SA302 summaries."},{"type":"fact","content":"If trading has been established for less than two years, we may accept the available period of accounts together with supporting bank statements. We will assess the continuity of earnings and the sustainability of the business before making a lending decision."},{"type":"fact","content":"For sole traders, we generally use net profit as shown in the most recent accounts or tax return, subject to any adjustments required by underwriting. For partners and directors, we may consider salary, dividends and share of profits where these are evidenced and consistent."},{"type":"fact","content":"Applicants must declare all sources of self-employed income, including seasonal work, consultancy fees and retained profits where relevant. Any income relied upon must be evidenced and, where necessary, supported by an accountant’s reference or business accountant’s letter."},{"type":"fact","content":"We do not rely solely on projected income unless this is accompanied by credible evidence of historic trading performance. Where income varies materially from year to year, we may use an averaged figure or the lower figure, depending on the circumstances."},{"type":"fact","content":"Business bank statements may be requested to confirm that declared receipts are consistent with the underlying accounts. We may also ask for explanations of unusual transactions, cash-based income or irregular drawings before proceeding."},{"type":"fact","content":"Where the self-employed applicant has other employed income, this may be assessed separately and added where it is sustainable and evidenced. Each income stream must be verified in its own right and should not be assumed to continue without supporting documents."},{"type":"fact","content":"We will not normally accept self-employed income where the business is subject to unresolved arrears, serious adverse tax liabilities or an evident decline in turnover without a satisfactory explanation. In such cases, further underwriting evidence may be required or the application may be declined."},{"type":"fact","content":"For annual review or affordability checks, self-employed customers may be asked to provide updated tax returns and the latest management accounts.
